title: a step fulfilling another use case's requirement
when: Loads a step of one use case's flow that fulfills a requirement of another use case.
then: Expects a `step-fulfills-own-use-case` refusal on the `fulfills` line, naming the requirement and its use case.

title: A second flow through one interface, and a second invoke of a step, are refused
when: Adds a second flow through an interface a flow already goes through, and a second invoke to a step.
then: Expects each refused by its unique key.

title: a policy hearing two events
when: Loads a policy that hears a second event of its domain.
then: Expects a `unique` refusal in `hears.jsonl`.

title: records another aggregate of the command's domain
when: Loads the fixture, whose command records a change of another aggregate of its domain, then adds command changes of the command's own aggregate and of another domain's aggregate.
then: Expects the fixture to load, and both added changes refused as `command-change-in-domain`.

title: An aggregate with two roots is refused, one with none is not
when: Adds a second root entity to an aggregate and changes a child to a root, then loads data files that give an aggregate two roots; adds a child to an aggregate with no root.
then: Expects each refused as aggregate-root with its reason and no file changed, the load refused naming aggregate.jsonl and its line, and the aggregate with no root kept.

title: A table for an entity stored in its root's table is refused, and so is an entity's table that is a view
when: Adds a table for a child entity stored in its root's table and changes an entity's table to a view; then loads data files with such a table, a root marked as stored in its root's table, and an entity's table stored as a view or a materialized view.
then: Expects the add refused as entity-table with its reason and the change as a check refusal, no file changed, and each load refused: entity-table naming table.jsonl, a check refusal for the root, the view and the materialized view.

title: A table's second primary key is refused, and so is a key whose parts do not fit its type
when: Changes a table to have two primary keys; then loads data files with a second primary key, and keys whose parts do not fit their type: an index with a condition, a primary key naming an invariant, a foreign key with no target table and an index with one.
then: Expects the change refused as one-primary-key with its reason and no file changed, the load refused as one-primary-key on the table, and a check refusal for each misplaced part.

title: a field with two types, or none
when: Gives the first entity, value object, event and read model field both a type and an aggregate type, then neither.
then: Expects a check refusal on each field table, for both and for neither.

title: A field name is unique in its entity or event trimmed and in any letter case
when: Loads, and writes, entity and event fields named like another of the same record but for spacing or case.
then: Expects each refused, naming the file and line or the command, the same name kept in two entities, and names that differ in more than spacing and case kept.

title: Two capabilities in one domain with the same position are refused; other domains may reuse it
when: With a domain that has a capability at position 1, adds a second capability at position 1, then another domain's capability at 1.
then: The second is refused as not unique, naming the first; the other domain's loads.

title: A repeated position on a path is refused by the store, and a path whose numbering skips is a step-order error
when: Loads two steps of one flow on one path, written `refused` and `Refused`, at positions 2 and 3 with no step at 1.
then: Expects one `step-order` error, on `EX-LEND-UC01-FL01-S03`, saying it has position 2 on path refused but no step of that path has position 1, and to number the steps of a path 1, 2, 3 with no gaps.

title: A pattern rule's setting or applies-when setting its pattern lacks, or an applies-when given in part, is refused by the store
when: With a pattern that has one setting, adds a rule naming a setting the pattern lacks, or giving part of its applies-when condition.
then: Refused by the foreign key and by the check; a rule with no condition loads.

title: A product's kind is declared once, under a kind that exists, by a name no Lathe table has, holds only its product's records, and never widens Lathe's kinds
when: With a product that declares its own kind under domain, declares the kind twice, names it after one of Lathe's tables, puts it under a kind that does not exist, gives a field to one of Lathe's kinds, or uses it for another product's record.
then: The product's records sit in their domain and Lathe's kinds keep their parents and required columns; each bad case is refused, naming it.

title: A product relation adds a link table of its own, and Lathe's relations keep their roles, labels and descriptions
when: Loads a product relation without its reverse label, then with a blank forward label, and reads Lathe's own relations.
then: Expects a `required` refusal naming `reverse_label`, a refusal on `product_relation` for the blank label, and every Lathe relation with both labels.

title: A product kind or relation without a description, or a check without its explanation, is refused
when: Loads a product kind with a blank description, a relation with none, and a check row with no explanation.
then: Expects each refused.

title: has_one or has_many to an entity in another aggregate is a has-crosses-aggregate error; refers_to may cross aggregates and domains
when: Adds a `has_many` from the loan entity to an entity of another aggregate.
then: Expects one `has-crosses-aggregate` error on `EX-LEND-EN01`, saying to reach it by a field typed by it.

title: A domain whose title names a technology layer, in any letter case, is a warning that says to name the capability
when: Adds domains titled Web app, Records (code `DB`), Shop (described as served by its own server) and Guided tours.
then: Expects `domain-named-for-technology` warnings for Web app and for Records, whose code `DB` gives `its code DB says "db"`, and none for Shop, only described as served by its own server, or Guided tours.

title: A title with no past form as its last word or after its first is an event-tense warning
when: Adds events titled Return tool, Loan became overdue, Fee needed and Speed.
then: Expects `event-tense` warnings for Return tool and Speed, and none for Loan became overdue or Fee needed.

title: A child entity its root does not reach by has_one or has_many is an entity-unreferenced warning
when: Removes every `has_one` link of the complete product, leaving a child entity its root does not reach.
then: Expects one `entity-unreferenced` warning, on `EX-LEND-EN02`.

title: A pattern rule test naming a domain that neither follows the pattern nor has a use case that does is an error
when: With a domain whose use case follows the pattern, adds a rule test naming a domain that does not follow it.
then: An error on that test; none once the domain follows the pattern.

title: An event a policy hears whose event type is not delivered by outbox is a warning
when: With an event a policy hears, delivered by outbox, changes its delivery to in process.
then: One warning naming the event, the policy and the event type.

title: A set changes and clears columns
when: Sets a column and clears another with null.
then: Expects the row changed and the cleared column left out of its line.

title: A repository that persists no aggregate is an error
when: With a complete product that has no `repository-persists-nothing` error, removes every persists link of one repository.
then: One repository-persists-nothing error names that repository; its aggregate shows as having no repository.

title: A second repository for one aggregate is refused, and so are a second aggregate for one repository and a second record of one identifier
when: Loads a second repository persisting an aggregate that already has one, a second repository with the same title and file as the first, and a repository persisting a second aggregate, then that aggregate recorded as a repository share instead.
then: Expects `unique` refusals on `persists.jsonl` for the shared target and the shared source, `title-unique` on both repositories of one identifier, and the share with its reason to load.

title: A flow whose ID does not end in its interface's number is refused
when: Adds a flow FL02 through TL-IF01 with Add a flow.
then: Expects a flow-id-interface refusal saying its ID is the use case's FL01.

title: A view for a step of a CLI flow is refused
when: Changes a step of a flow through a CLI interface to happen in a view.
then: Expects a step-fits-interface refusal.

title: An open question owned by a role its product lacks is refused
when: Adds a question owned by a role its product lacks, then changes the product's roles to drop one a question names.
then: Expects a question-owner-role refusal naming the question, the owner and the product's roles, and no file changed.

title: A record of a product's kind under another product's domain is refused
when: Adds a record of TL's kind under another product's domain with Add an extension record.
then: Expects a product-kind-product refusal with its reason, and no file changed.

title: A policy hearing another domain's unpublished event is refused
when: Changes a policy to hear, and adds one hearing, an unpublished event of another domain; then loads data files where a policy hears it, and again once the event is published.
then: Expects each refused as policy-hears-published with its reason and no file changed, the load refused naming hears.jsonl and its line, and the published event to load.

title: A read model fed by another domain's unpublished event is refused
when: Changes a read model to be fed by, and adds one fed by, an unpublished event of another domain; then loads data files where a read model is fed by it, and again once the event is published.
then: Expects each refused as read-model-fed-by-published with its reason and no file changed, the load refused naming fed_by.jsonl and its line, and the published event to load.

title: A foreign key to another domain's table is refused
when: Changes a table to have a foreign key to another domain's table, then loads data files with one.
then: Expects the change refused as foreign-key-crosses-domain with its reason and no file changed, and the load refused naming table_key.jsonl.

title: A key of or to a table kept outside a database is refused
when: Changes a table with keys to each storage outside a database, and gives a table a foreign key to one; then loads data files where a table with keys, and one a foreign key points at, is kept outside a database, and again without those keys.
then: Expects each refused as key-outside-database with its reason and no file changed, the load refused once per key, and the data to load once the keys are gone.

title: A product check named like one of Lathe's checks is refused by the store, so it never runs
when: Opens a store on the complete product and adds a product check named `view-unused`, like one of Lathe's checks.
then: Expects the add refused with a `StoreError` holding a `primary-key` refusal that names `one of Lathe's own (lathe/data/check.jsonl)`.

title: Lathe's checks are read-only
when: Opens a product beside Lathe's checks, tries to change and to remove one of them, and adds a check of the product's own.
then: Expects both refused as built-in, lathe/data/check.jsonl unchanged, and only the product's own check in the product's data/check.jsonl.

title: Every check row has a one-sentence summary, an explanation and a severity that matches its query
when: Reads every row of Lathe's `lathe/data/check.jsonl`.
then: Expects a one-sentence summary, an explanation, and the severity `error_or_warning` exactly when its query returns a severity column.

title: Each check is one SELECT query in its row, and Lathe's checks are named and placed in order
when: Reads every row of Lathe's `lathe/data/check.jsonl`.
then: Expects positions 1, 2, 3 and so on with no product, each query a single SELECT or WITH statement, and every kind a check names one of Lathe's.

title: A product has at most one settings row
when: Loads two product_setting rows for one product.
then: Expects one primary-key refusal on the second, naming line 1.

title: Every page has its own address, and back and forward move between pages
when: Parses addresses with and without the spec index, opens `/DM-SHOP-UC01-R01` directly, follows the menu's Shopping link and its Checks link, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects `/DM` a product page, `/DM-SHOP` a domain page (a record page without the index), a record ID a record page, `/DM-SHOP/domain-model/aggregate` a group, `/` the products, and `/specs/DM/DM-SHOP/graph`, `/format`, `/settings/appearance` and `/nothing-here` missing; the heading `The basket shows the new item` on the direct open; the address `/DM-SHOP`, then `/DM-SHOP?panel=checks` with the Checks region open; and Back and Forward showing Shopping, the record, then Shopping again.

title: A link in the wiki card re-centers the graph and the header strip, and a click on the stage moves the card
when: Opens a use case on the Graph stage at depth 2, follows a requirement's link in the wiki card, then clicks the requirement's sibling on the stage.
then: Expects the address, the header strip's title, the graph's center and the card's text on the requirement; then the address `?stage=graph`, the card and the center on the sibling.

title: The stage a link names opens and is remembered, so a new session's first page opens on it
when: Opens a use case with `?stage=trace`, clears the session and opens another record with no stage.
then: Expects `trace` remembered as the stage, and the other record opening on the Trace stage with Graph not pressed.

title: Choosing a space opens its last page this session
when: Opens `/DM-SHOP-UC01`, then Notebook from the rail and its Notes page.
then: Expects session storage `lathe:space-pages` to hold `DM` at `/DM-SHOP-UC01` and `NF` at `/NF-NOTE`, and nothing under that key in local storage.

title: What is folded is remembered for the session, and every record is listed without sections
when: Unfolds Shopping's Test plan in the nav, then opens the product's page with Checks over it.
then: Expects Test plan of Shopping still unfolded on the product's page with Checks over it, and nothing kept under `lathe:nav-folders` in local storage.

title: A move never leaves its tab, and a page may be open in several tabs, each its own
when: Moves the active tab of a set of two onto the page the other holds, then changes the stage of each.
then: Expects the same tab active after the move, both tabs on the page, and each tab's stage its own.

title: There is always a tab: closing activates the right neighbor, else the left, and closing the last leaves one tab on the product
when: Closes the active first tab of three, then the rightmost, then the last.
then: Expects the right neighbor active after the first close, the left neighbor after the second, and after the last one tab on the product. Unknown keys change nothing.

title: Each tab's place is its own, duplicating copies it with its history, and a stored set is read back with anything malformed dropped
when: Changes one tab's place, duplicates it, and reads back a stored set.
then: Expects the other tab's place unchanged; the duplicate after it with the same place and history, then going its own way; and a stored set read back with a bad path, a bad place and a bad history dropped, and an unknown active tab replaced by the first.

title: Opening, activating, cycling and closing tabs never touch the window's settings; only the person's change does
when: The session's settings set to Nested with the minimap on, and the tab's depth 2. Opens a page in the tab, opens another in a new tab, activates the first, cycles and closes tabs; then changes the settings.
then: Expects the session's settings unchanged after every tab move and no tab's place to hold them; the change alone changes them.

title: Every command has a title, and no binding clashes or takes a browser key
when: Runs the duplicate-binding check over the keymap on a Mac and elsewhere, then over the keymap with a command `x` added on Mod+B and a command `y` added on `g`.
then: Expects no duplicate binding on either platform; `Ctrl+B: toggleNav and x` for the clash; and a clash between `goChecks` and `y` for the sequence prefix.

title: A theme exports as a versioned file and imports back, and anything but known tokens is refused
when: Reads a partial theme file that sets only the light `--ink`.
then: Expects the missing `--paper` taken from Lathe: `#F4F6F5` in light and `#11171B` in dark.

title: A built-in theme is changed only through a copy, and reset puts the copy back to its built-in
when: Duplicates Workshop in Appearance, changes the copy's light accent, then resets it to Workshop.
then: Expects the copy in use as `custom-workshop-copy`, its stylesheet to carry `--steel: #123456;` after the change and `--steel: #9C3F17;` after Reset to Workshop, the editor still titled `Edit “Workshop copy”`, and Workshop's own light accent still `#9C3F17`.

title: Deleting the theme in use puts Lathe back in use
when: Duplicates Workshop in Appearance, which puts the copy in use, then deletes the copy after confirming.
then: Expects the address back at `?panel=appearance` and the theme in use `lathe`.

title: A second launch or a folder from Finder goes to the running app, which opens or focuses its window
when: Records `/work/shop` as open in a window, then looks up the window for `/work/shop/`, `/work/./shop` and `/work/other`.
then: Expects the window open for `/work/shop` found for `/work/shop/` and `/work/./shop`, and none for another folder.

title: In development the window uses the 5199 server only when it answers for the opened folder
when: Asks for a free port, then for one avoiding 5199 and a port another server holds.
then: Expects the shared port to be 5199, and neither free port to be 5199 or the held port.

title: The recent folders list puts the latest first, each folder once, at most 10
when: Adds folders to the list, adds one again, adds twelve, and reads saved lists with junk in them.
then: Expects a new folder first; a folder added again moved to the top (with a trailing slash too) rather than listed twice; at most 10 kept, the oldest dropped; and a saved list read with non-strings, empty strings and repeats dropped, its order kept and cut to 10.

title: A refused command leaves the data and the files as they were
when: Applies three commands as one write (add a view, link it, add an automated test with no file), the last of which the store refuses.
then: Expects one problem with rule `check` on command 2, no trace of the view in the records or the database, and every data file unchanged.

title: A write checks the validation queries before any file changes
when: Sets a child entity's role to root, so its aggregate has two roots.
then: Expects the write refused by the `aggregate-root` validation query, naming the aggregate.

title: An add rewrites only its own table's file, sorted, with the ID registered
when: Adds a requirement.
then: Expects the add to report the table `uc_requirement` and the file `uc_requirement.jsonl`, the ID registered in `record_id` and `obligation` as a `uc_requirement`, only `uc_requirement.jsonl` changed, and the new row on line 2 with its columns in the table's order.

title: Writes run one after another, each on the state the one before left
when: Starts three adds at once.
then: Expects all three rows, in order, and a side connection that reads all of them.

title: A refused add names its rule and command: a key that exists, a bad parent, a link table
when: Adds a view with an ID in use, a view requirement under a view that does not exist, and a row straight into the `reads` link table.
then: Expects `primary-key` on command 0, `foreign-key` with the message `view_requirement TL-V09-R01: view_id "TL-V09" names no view`, and a `command` refusal that says to use link.

title: A row without a required field is refused
when: For each kind, loads its first row without each required column other than its ID and parent columns, then with each enum column set to `bogus`.
then: Expects a `required` refusal on line 1 saying `<kind>.<column> is required`, and a `column` refusal on line 1 saying the value `is not one of` the enum's values.

title: A setting value gives a value or a reason
when: Loads setting values with both a value and a reason, with neither, and with an empty reason.
then: Expects each refused, and a reason alone to load.

title: Each followed pattern's settings take their own values
when: A use case follows two patterns that both have a record setting, and gives a value for the first only.
then: Expects one pattern-setting-missing error naming the second pattern, and none once it gives that pattern its own value.

title: A setting value answers a setting of a pattern its follower follows
when: Loads the every-kind fixture with its `follows` links removed, so its setting value answers a pattern its use case no longer follows.
then: Expects the store to refuse it as a `foreign-key` refusal at `data/setting_value.jsonl`, line 1.

title: A use case that gives no value for one of its pattern's settings is an error naming the setting
when: Loads the complete product, then the same with every setting value removed, so its use case gives no value for its pattern's setting `record`.
then: Expects no pattern-setting-missing error for the complete product, and one naming the setting for a use case that gives no value for it.
